title: Length-Prefixed Chunked Key-Value Store
prompt:
Implement `BasicKVStore(files, name='snapshot.bin')` and `ChunkedKVStore(files, prefix='kv', chunk_size=1024)`. Both stores expose `set(key, value)`, `get(key, default=None)`, `snapshot()`, and `restore()`. Keys and values are strings and may contain Unicode, empty strings, newlines, delimiters, and NUL characters. `files` has `write(name, bytes)`, `read(name)`, `list(prefix)`, and `delete(name)`.

Encode map entries as a deterministic length-prefixed byte stream; do not rely on a delimiter, pickle, or JSON for key/value payloads. `BasicKVStore` writes one blob. `ChunkedKVStore` splits the blob into chunks no larger than `chunk_size`, writes a new generation, then commits a manifest naming exactly that generation. Restore reads only the committed manifest so stale chunks are ignored. A malformed or incomplete snapshot raises `ValueError` and leaves existing memory unchanged. `restore()` returns `False` when no committed snapshot exists and `True` after a successful restore.

example.output: a later fresh store restores the same mapping
example.reasoning: Byte lengths, not delimiters, define record boundaries.
